SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI
C. 86 Stn. Station
No. S. B. D. 2588/1.
Date July 20, 19 31
also 20 - 7 - 31

Subject (in full) Anti-Japanese Movement

Made by ______ and Forwarded by C.D.I. Robertson

In view of the serious attempts being made by the
Chinese Chamber of Commerce, local organizations and labour unions
to institute a boycott of Japanese goods and to inaugurate an
anti-Japanese movement all of which will no doubt find impetus in
the Memorial Service to be held in the Chamber of Commerce Building
North Honan Road during the forenoon of July 23 for the Chinese
immigrants killed in the recent anti-Chinese movement on the part
of Koreans, it is suggested that it may be necessary for the
police to adopt special precautions on that day in the vicinity
of the Chamber of Commerce building. It will be remembered that
one of the resolutions passed at a meeting held in the Soy Shop
Owners' Guild, Foh Yeu Road, City, on July 19, by some 26 repre-
sentatives of various local labour unions was as under:-
"That local labour unions be asked to notify local workers to
declare a half holiday on July 23 and participate in the Memorial
Service to be held in the Chamber of Commerce Building, North
Honan Road, on the forenoon of July 23 for the Chinese immigrants
killed in the recent anti-Chinese movement on the part of the
Koreans."
It is reported that the various committees elected to
direct activities in connection with the anti-Japanese movement
will be formally inaugurated at the meeting and it is possible
that some of the more irresponsible "patriotic" elements of
the attendance may attempt to put their plans into action on
leaving the building.

Henry Robertson
C. D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch

（批：File 21.7.31）
（批：Commissioner of Police, Sir, Copies of this report have been sent to S.B. (Bunnes) Land S.B. (Bunnes). Administrator 21/7/31）

日期 1931年7月20日
另注 20 - 7 - 31

主题（全称） 反日运动

由 ______ 制作，经 C.D.I. Robertson 转呈

鉴于上海总商会、本地各团体及工会正极力试图发起抵制日货并启动反日运动，而所有这些活动无疑将在7月23日上午于北河南路总商会大楼举行的追悼会上得到推动，该追悼会旨在悼念近期在朝鲜人发起的反华运动中遇害的中国侨民。因此建议，警方有必要在该日于总商会大楼附近采取特别预防措施。需指出的是，7月19日在南市福佑路豆业公所举行的一次会议上，约26名本地各工会代表通过了一项决议，内容如下：
“请本地各工会通知本地工人，于7月23日放假半天，并参加将于7月23日上午在北河南路总商会大楼举行的追悼会，以悼念近期在朝鲜人发起的反华运动中遇害的中国侨民。”
据报，为指挥反日运动相关活动而选出的各委员会将在该次会议上正式成立，且与会者中一些较为不负责任的“爱国”分子可能会在离开大楼后试图将其计划付诸行动。

Henry Robertson
刑事侦缉督察 (C. D. I.)

特别课主管警官

（批注：归档 21.7.31）
（批注：警务处长阁下，本报告副本已送交特别课 (Bunnes) 及土地特别课 (Bunnes)。行政官 21/7/31）

Subject (in full) Anti-Japanese Movement

Made by / and ________________________ Forwarded by C.D.I. Robertson

According to the Sin Wan Pao of July 20, the Korean League
has issued a manifesto to the effect that Chinese and Koreans
are brethren and that the League is willing to cooperate with
the Chinese in overthrowing the Japanese Imperialists.

I therefore suggest that D.S. Kim or D.S. Umemoto be
instructed to pay special attention to the activities of local
Korean organizations and secret societies..

MESSAGE TO THE BRITISH PRESS.

The Min Kuo Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
    The Shanghai Chamber of Commerce yesterday
sent a telegram to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
requesting it to lodge a strongly-worded protest with
the Japanese Government regarding the attacks made by
the Korean mobs against the Chinese residents in Korea.
The Chamber also suggests that the Ministry should draw
up a special agreement with Japan governing the Korean
farmers in Manchuria and Mongolia and Chinese residents
in Korea similar to to the Sino-French Annamite Treaty.
* * * * * *
    The 3rd, 6th and 7th District Local
Resident Associations have issued manifestoes denouncing
the Korean mobs who attacked the Chinese residents in
Korea under the instigation of the Japanese imperialists.
They advocate that the National Government lodge a protest
with the Japanese Government and also adopt measures
to protect the Chinese residing in Korea.

2. The Wanpaosen Incident - Activities of local Koreans

The amalgamated Association of local Korean organizations
which has been organized with the object of demonstrating to
the Chinese public that the anti-Chinese movement in Korea was
purposely fomented by the Japanese, at a meeting held recently
in the headquarters of the Provisional Government of Korea, No.
Poo Ching Li (普慶里), Rue Brenier de Montmorency, French
Concession, passed the following resolutions :-

1. That manifestoes in Chinese be issued to the various newspapers
and periodicals declaring that the recent outrages perpetrated
by Koreans against Chinese nationals in Korea were due to
the instigation of the Japanese authorities.

2. That funds be raised from Korean residents to defray expenses
to be incurred in carrying out this propaganda.

3. That the names of as many different Korean organizations
as possible be contained as signatories in these manifestoes
so that the public may know that the movement is being fully
supported.

4. That representatives be appointed to attend the various
meetings held by the Chinese to arouse the people to the
atrocities committed against Chinese nationals in Korea
by Koreans at the instigation of the Japanese.

Reg. / Please attach to report on
this subject submitted by J.S.
Umemoto.
J.B.R.
22/7.

2. 万宝山事件 - 本地朝鲜人的活动

本地朝鲜组织联合协会，其成立目的在于向中国公众表明，朝鲜的反华运动是由日本人故意煽动的。该协会最近在法租界孟莫朗西路（Rue Brenier de Montmorency）普庆里4号朝鲜临时政府总部举行会议，通过了以下决议：

1. 向各报刊发布中文宣言，声明近期朝鲜人在朝鲜对中国国民犯下的暴行是由于日本当局的煽动所致。

2. 向朝鲜居民募集资金，以支付开展此宣传活动的费用。

3. 在这些宣言中尽可能列入不同朝鲜组织的名称作为签署方，以便公众知晓该运动得到充分支持。

4. 指派代表出席中国人举行的各类会议，以唤起民众关注朝鲜人在日本煽动下对中国国民在朝鲜所犯下的暴行。

登记室 / 请附在 J.S.
Umemoto 提交的关于此主题的报告后。
J.B.R.
22/7.

INDIAN? ANNAMITE AND KOREAN APPEAL REGARDING JAPANESE
INTRIGUE

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report :-
The Korean, Annamite and Indian revolutionists
in Shanghai yesterday issued the following manifesto
expressing sympathy for the suffering Chinese residents
in Korea:-
"To the Chinese people,
While the oppressed races of Asia are
endeavouring to establish unity, a great massacre of
Chinese residing in Korea suddenly breaks out by Koreans.
This calamity is really unprecedented in history and
the world is staggered at its proportions. The Korean
people although ignorant, will not kill Chinese people
from whose country the wave of revolution emanates
and thus impede their own emancipation. The instigator,
under whose oppression such atrocities have been
committed, cannot deny this. The only saviour to
whom our weak and oppressed nations are looking is
China. Fearing the realization of such a union, the
imperialists, pursuing their unjust and barbarous policy,
have created this disaster in order that they may further
their mad aim to invade Manchuria and Mongolia and
obstruct the unification of the oppressed races. Should
the Chinese Authorities refuse to take strong actions to
settle the incident, the French will also instigate the
Annamites and the British will force the Indians to massacre
one another.
"In pledging our faith to the revolutionary
spirit of the late Dr. Sun Yat Sen to secure the
unification of the oppressed races, our colleagues, in
addition to sending telegrams to our peoples disclosing
the Japanese intrigue, hereby request every one to
remain firm against our common foes.
Pek Huk In (朴國人), Korean Independent Party
Loh Tscong Shung (陸仲勳), Annamite Kuomintang.
Dz Ya Sing (是也幸), Indian Youth League".

Co-operation with S4.
SS. Umemoto.

关于日本阴谋的印度人、安南人和朝鲜人呼吁书

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
在上海的朝鲜、安南和印度革命者昨日发表以下宣言，对居住在朝鲜的受苦中国居民表示同情：
“致中国人民：
当亚洲被压迫民族正努力建立团结之际，朝鲜人突然对在朝华人发动大屠杀。这场灾难在历史上实属空前，其规模令世界震惊。朝鲜人民虽然愚昧，但绝不会杀害作为革命浪潮发源地的中国人民，从而阻碍他们自身的解放。在此类暴行所遭受的压迫下，煽动者无法否认这一事实。我们弱小和被压迫的民族所仰望的唯一救星是中国。帝国主义列强担心这种联合成为现实，推行其不公正和野蛮的政策，制造了这场灾难，以便进一步推进其入侵满洲和蒙古的疯狂目标，并阻碍被压迫民族的统一。如果中国当局拒绝采取有力行动解决此事，法国人也将煽动安南人，英国人将迫使印度人互相残杀。
“为了信守已故孙中山博士的革命精神以确保被压迫民族的统一，我们的同志除了向我国人民发送电报揭露日本阴谋外，特此请求每个人在面对共同敌人时保持坚定。

On July 10, the local Korean revolutionary leaders
named Kim Ku, Kim Chul, Li Tong Nung, Li Shi Yung, An Chang Ho,
Cho Wan Ku, Cho So Ang, issued a joint manifesto in the Chinese
language regarding the recent Sino-Korean disturbances express-
ing their deepest regrets for the Chinese killed and injured
during the recent riots in Korea. I obtained a copy of this
manifesto and attach it herewith together with translation.
The Korean revolutionists also explain that this
most lamentable incident was not created with their knowledge
but was instigated by the Imperialistic Japanese and they
appeal to the Chinese nation as a whole to think the matter
over wisely with a cool head in order to make no mistake.

H. S. Kim
D. S.

7月10日，当地朝鲜革命领袖金九（Kim Ku）、金哲（Kim Chul）、李东宁（Li Tong Nung）、李始荣（Li Shi Yung）、安昌浩（An Chang Ho）、赵完九（Cho Wan Ku）、赵素昂（Cho So Ang）就最近的朝中 disturbances 发表了一份联合中文宣言，对在最近朝鲜骚乱中伤亡的中国人表示最深切的遗憾。我获得了这份宣言的副本，并将其连同译文附后。
朝鲜革命者还解释说，这一最令人痛心的事件并非在他们知情的情况下制造，而是由帝国主义日本煽动的，他们呼吁全中国人民冷静理智地思考此事，以免犯错。

H. S. Kim
D. S.

特别支部主管官员。
（批注：31年7月20日）

page_data.en:
July 10, 1931.

The following is a brief translation of the manifesto issued
by the Korean revolutionary leaders:-
(1) The Korean independent party and Korean immigrants in
China have unanimously decided to do their best to throw
off the yoke of Japanese imperialism in the three Eastern
provinces both in theory and in practice, and absolutely
refuse to be the tools of the Japanese. The Chinese
are requested to recognise this fact.
(2) The Korean Revolutionary independent party and the Korean
immigrants in the Three Eastern Provinces are closely
related in their aims. The Korean emigrants' interest
in the Three Eastern Provinces will be directly responsible
for the success or failure of the Korean independence
movement in future and, for this reason, should China
oppress the Koreans in that place, it will means that
China simultaneously is oppressing the Korean independence
movement. We hope that China will pay special attention
to this when dealing with the Koreans.
(3) The emancipation from the Japanese of the three Eastern
Provinces of China and the independence of Korea can be
considered as identical movements, and both Chinese and
Korean immigrants are therefore expected to join hands in
the general struggle.
(4) It may be true that Japan employs Koreans as her tools by
affording them slight protection, but if China were to
extend to the Korean immigrants proper protection, then
they would support China wholeheartedly. Consequently it
is to be hoped that the Chinese officials and people will
persue a policy that will help realize the aspirations of
the Korean immigrants.
(5) In the Wanposhan incidents there were no relations between
the Korean immigrants in China and the farmers of Wanposhan.
The Korean farmers were forced by the Japanese Police to
go to Wanposhan to cultivate the farms.
(6) The riots were completely instigated by the Japanese
imperialists. These riots resemble those that occurred at
the time of the Japanese Earthquake and during the Shantung
incident. The Chinese are requested to understand this
as well, and to try their best to drive away their foe.

1931年7月10日。

以下是朝鲜革命领袖发表的宣言的简要译文：
(1) 朝鲜独立党和在华朝鲜移民已一致决定，无论在理论上还是实践上，都将竭尽全力摆脱日本帝国主义在东三省的枷锁，并绝对拒绝成为日本的工具。请中国人认清这一事实。
(2) 朝鲜革命独立党与在东三省的朝鲜移民在目标上密切相关。朝鲜移民在东三省的利益将直接决定未来朝鲜独立运动的成败，因此，如果中国在该地压迫朝鲜人，那就意味着中国同时在压迫朝鲜独立运动。我们希望中国在处理朝鲜人问题时特别注意这一点。
(3) 中国东三省从日本统治下解放与朝鲜独立可视为同一运动，因此期望中朝移民携手进行总体斗争。
(4) 日本通过提供轻微保护而利用朝鲜人作为其工具，这可能是事实，但如果中国能给予朝鲜移民适当的保护，那么他们将全心全意支持中国。因此，希望中国官员和人民实行一项有助于实现朝鲜移民愿望的政策。
(5) 在万宝山事件中，在华朝鲜移民与万宝山的农民之间没有任何关系。朝鲜农民是被日本警察强迫前往万宝山耕种农田的。
(6) 骚乱完全由日本帝国主义者煽动。这些骚乱类似于日本大地震时期和山东事件期间发生的骚乱。请中国人也理解这一点，并尽力驱逐他们的敌人。
